faq.q: Which is the best SAP training institute in Hyderabad?
faq.a: Placeonix is a trusted SAP and IT training institute in Hyderabad's Financial District, offering SAP BTP, CPI, CAPM, RAP, UI5/Fiori, ABAP on S/4HANA, FICO, MM, SD and BASIS. With small batches of maximum 30, live real-time projects, internship access and 100% placement assistance, learners get hands-on training aligned with real hiring needs.

faq.q: Do you provide IT training with placement in Hyderabad?
faq.a: Yes. Every Placeonix program includes complete placement assistance — resume building, mock interviews, LinkedIn optimisation, recruiter connects and job referrals with our partner companies. Eligible students receive interview preparation, job referrals and continued placement guidance.

faq.q: What courses does Placeonix offer in Hyderabad?
faq.a: We offer SAP modules (BTP, CPI, CAPM, RAP, UI5/Fiori, ABAP, FICO, MM, SD, BASIS), Data Science & Analytics, DevOps & Cloud Engineering, Full Stack Web Development, Java Backend, Cybersecurity Fundamentals and UI/UX Design, plus combo packages such as SAP Integration Expert and AI + Data Science.

faq.q: Where is Placeonix located in Hyderabad?
faq.a: Placeonix is located at Kapil Kavuri Hub, No. 144, 9th Floor, 152, Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana 500032. We are open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM – 7 PM IST. Call +91 99494 94020 or +91 91217 59191.

faq.q: Are the training programs suitable for freshers and working professionals?
faq.a: Yes. Our SAP and IT courses are designed for freshers, career switchers and working professionals. Batches run 6 days a week with multiple timings per day, so you can learn alongside your job or studies.

faq.q: Do you offer online or classroom SAP training in Hyderabad?
faq.a: We offer instructor-led training with real system access, live projects and personalised mentoring. Contact our admissions team to discuss classroom and online options that fit your schedule.
